result.line: Self-hosted arb executor: 16 calls / 7 d (2.3/day) from 9 EOAs, caller supplied swap plan (1.4-3.7 kB calldata), contract ends flat in tokens and splits the ETH - ~95% to 0x4838b106..5f97 ($1.33-$103.80/call, mean $28) and $0.59-$8.07 to the caller (one 0.817 ETH = $1,328 sweep); gas $3.16-$14.20/call (sample of 6 of 16); own funds, no protocol job.
